paragraphs: Rav Huna the priest, son of Moshe bar Atzur: end of Bava Batra, 174b. In chapter Shum HaYetomim, 23a, Moshe bar Atzur was guarantor for his daughter-in-law. His son Rav Huna was a Torah scholar and in straitened circumstances. Abaye said, “Is there no one to advise Rav Huna to divorce his wife, so she can demand her marriage settlement from his father, and then take her back …?” In the end it became known that he was a priest. Abaye said, “Poverty follows the poor.”
